sites.access_route_summary: Accessible parking is adjacent to the east entrance; step-free route is signed from the parking area to check-in.
sites.curbside_instructions_summary: Call the listed number or use the curbside alert sign at the east entrance. Election workers will verify check-in and provide the official curbside voting process.
sites.alternate_access_path: If the primary east entrance is blocked, use the signed south ramp entrance or call the accessibility help line for staff assistance.

freshness_note: Accessibility and curbside status refreshes within 15 minutes of an approved public change notice during active voting periods.
